description: Body Battery per day over a date range: how much it charged and drained, and the events behind it — sleep, each activity, rest and stress periods — with start time, duration, impact on Body Battery and Garmin's feedback. Set include_samples for the level through the day (averaged per 30 min). For daily max / min Body Battery use garmin_get_daily_summaries. Defaults to the last 7 days; at most 31 days per call.

end_date.description: Last day (inclusive), YYYY-MM-DD. Default: today, or 6 days after start_date (not past today).

include_samples.description: Include levels averaged per 30 minutes. Default false.

start_date.description: First day, YYYY-MM-DD in the user's time zone. Default: 6 days before end_date. At most 31 days per call.

name: garmin_get_body_battery
title: Get Garmin Body Battery
